key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between usage refreshes; 0 refreshes only on demand. Forwarded to the helper as refreshInterval.

key.name: animation-quality
key.description: Minimum frame duration of the top-bar sprite: 0.4 s (powerSaver), 0.2 s (balanced) or 0.1 s (smooth).

key.name: limit-display-mode
key.description: Show official limits as the percentage used or the percentage remaining.

key.name: daily-trend-window
key.description: Days shown by the daily bar chart in the popover.

key.name: activity-view
key.description: What the popover's activity panel shows: the daily bars or the 16-week heatmap. Clicking the panel switches it.

key.name: week-start
key.description: Start of "This week". Forwarded to the helper as an ISO weekday (weekStart).

key.name: growth-difficulty
key.description: Multiplier on hatch and evolution thresholds. Forwarded to the helper as growthDifficulty.

key.name: shop-difficulty
key.description: Multiplier on Shop prices. Forwarded to the helper as shopDifficulty; applies immediately.

key.name: show-tokens-in-menu
key.summary: Show today's tokens in the top bar

key.summary: Show today's cost in the top bar

key.name: show-growth-in-menu
key.summary: Show the companion's growth in the top bar

key.name: show-limit-in-menu
key.summary: Show the official limit percentage in the top bar

key.name: menu-limit-color-mode
key.description: gauge colors every pace tier; attention only items running faster than pace; off none.

key.name: always-faces-back
key.description: Draw the companion facing away. Forwarded to the helper as alwaysFacesBack.

key.name: warn-threshold
key.description: Step 5. Forwarded as warnThreshold; the helper keeps it at least 5 points below the critical threshold.

key.name: companion-notifications
